dedupe_keys.name: liguria lithology and stone georesources for quarry planning

description: Region of Liguria publishes the harmonised lithology and stone-georesource layers produced as a starting point for the PTRAC quarry-activity territorial plan, with scientific input from the University of Genoa DISTAV. Coverage is Liguria. The source-defined quarry-planning role provides geological constraints for extractive-industry capacity planning simulations. The grouped resource has 6 native metadata entries; versions, map sheets and complementary representations are retained together where the provider defines the same resource. The metadata permits public access and states a Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 licence. Metadata is publicly readable; charges for obtaining or using the underlying material are not established here. Access is through the linked native metadata, which lists the provider routes and declared formats. The geology is supporting planning information, not an inventory of operating quarries or confirmed extractable reserves. Dataset and WMS/WFS metadata are grouped. Accuracy and current completeness remain unverified. No distribution, map, feature or document body was downloaded. Descriptive metadata dates range from 2022-05-19 to 2022-05-19; these dates are not treated as asset observation dates. Related regional or municipal inventories describe other physical assets or broader source catalogues.
